newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bourse to open only two days next week.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bourse to open only two days next week.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) will be open for trading only on Sunday and Tuesday next week, a KSE official said on Friday.

The bourse will close for Monday's general election, a Kashmir solidarity day on Wednesday and a local religious holiday on Thursday, he said. The KSE's trading week starts on Sunday after the Friday-Saturday weekend.
On Thursday, the KSE 100-share index closed 22.06 points, or 1.46 percent, up at 1,534.21 with 213 gainers and 34 losers on turnover of 43.7 million, up from Wednesday's 40.2 million.
